The legal basis varies depending on the specific purpose for which we use personal information. We use:
• Execução de um contrato, para tomar medidas a seu pedido antes da celebração de um contrato ou para comunicar consigo.
• Performance of a contract, to take steps at your request prior entering into a contract, or to communicate with you.

When you consent to our processing your personal information for a specified purpose, you may withdraw your consent at any time and we will stop processing of your data for that purpose.

• Compliance with a legal obligation when we use your personal information to comply with laws.
